name: Abatacept
route_note: IV infusion every 4 weeks after loading or weekly subcutaneous injection

discovery.by: Peter Linsley, Jeffrey Ledbetter and colleagues (Bristol-Myers Squibb)
discovery.note: Fusion of the extracellular domain of human CTLA-4 to a modified human IgG1 Fc.

tagline: CTLA-4–Fc fusion that blocks T-cell costimulation in rheumatoid arthritis
summary: Abatacept is a fusion protein of CTLA-4 and an immunoglobulin Fc that blocks the CD28 costimulatory signal needed for full T-cell activation. It is used in rheumatoid arthritis, juvenile idiopathic arthritis and psoriatic arthritis, and for prevention of acute graft-versus-host disease.
mechanism: Naïve T cells need two signals: antigen recognition through the T-cell receptor and costimulation through CD28 binding CD80/CD86 on antigen-presenting cells.

Abatacept binds CD80 and CD86 with higher affinity than CD28, blocking costimulation and reducing T-cell activation, proliferation and downstream cytokine and autoantibody production. Its modified Fc does not fix complement or mediate ADCC.
uses: Prophylaxis of acute graft-versus-host disease (with a calcineurin inhibitor and methotrexate)

history.title: CTLA4Ig described
history.detail: Linsley and colleagues report a soluble CTLA-4–immunoglobulin fusion that blocks CD28 costimulation.

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: Approved in December for rheumatoid arthritis.

history.title: Juvenile arthritis
history.detail: Approved for polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis.

history.title: Subcutaneous form
history.detail: Weekly subcutaneous abatacept approved for RA.

history.title: Graft-versus-host disease
history.detail: FDA approves abatacept for aGVHD prophylaxis, the first drug for this use.

pk.excretion: Not renally excreted as intact antibody; cleared by catabolism and target-mediated uptake

facts: Belatacept, a related CTLA-4–Fc molecule with higher affinity, is used in kidney transplantation.
Combination with TNF inhibitors increased serious infections without added benefit and is not recommended.
